items.headline: Neocloud bonds tumble as lenders pull back from AI debt ahead of CoreWeave earnings
items.note: Reported 14-21% drops in Iren, Nebius and Cipher bonds suggest funding stress is spreading across the neocloud group; figures come from a single aggregator.

items.headline: CoreWeave bond yield tops 16% as AI credit stress rises
items.note: CoreWeave's 2032 notes yield over 16% and five-year CDS is above 1,150-1,200bp, so the market is pricing neocloud distress days before Q3 earnings.

items.headline: Oracle prices $10B of notes at 7%-8.65% coupons
items.note: High coupons on Oracle's new issue show a rising funding cost for AI buildout debt; a reported BBB- rating is unverified.
